subject: scorpion
readings: head at -x: claws/pedipalps sit at x=0-9 in the XY panel, so XY is the PROFILE view; XZ (x across, z 'up') is the DORSAL/top view (claws upper-left x=0-8, tail centerline running to x=24); ZY is the FRONT view (body dome centered z=12, legs splayed left/right of it).
XY panel: claw tip (0,14), claw elbow (6,14), mouth/head_base (9,14) -- claw droops slightly toward ground.
XY panel: body/leg-attach line at y=15 running x=10,12,14,16 (four leg pairs along the carapace); ground line at y=19 where feet land.
XY panel: abdomen posterior end (17,13); tail arcs up to its high point (21,6); tail hooks back down to the stinger tip (19,8).

XZ (dorsal) panel: claws occupy x=0-8 spread to z=0 and mirrored to z=24 about centerline z=12; leg pairs radiate from the body block x=9-17 out to about z=2 and z=22; tail stays on the centerline z=12 from x=17 to x=24, confirming the tail curl is purely a y-motion (visible only in XY), not a sideways one.
ZY (front) panel: body dome center (12,14) with y=10 top / y=18 bottom; legs splay symmetrically from about z=3 to z=21 with feet meeting the ground at y=19, matching the XY ground reading.
notes: Cephalothorax is fused (no separate head leaf, per the carapace rule). Root 'head_base' placed at the anterior tip where the fused head/thorax meets the pedipalps. The spine is modeled as a chain head_base -> leg_base1..4 (the four points along the carapace where each leg pair actually attaches, per the crab/scorpion rule) -> abdomen -> tail_mid -> tail_tip(stinger, the external-tail leaf). Each pedipalp is enlarged into a claw, so it is coded as a 2-segment limb (elbow+tip) rather than sub-flap detail, per the 'enlarged pedipalp = limb' rule. Each of the 4 leg pairs is a 2-segment limb (knee, foot) attached independently as its own L/R chain to its own leg_base spine node -- no shared/forked chains. All four leg pairs and both claws were given identical proportional geometry (only their spine attachment point differs), since the mid-stride pose differences in the render are not to be encoded, only proportions. Tail was split into base/arc/tip; this 2-joint split is an inferred simplification of the visibly more-segmented curling tail. Left/right sides use +z/-z respectively; verified hip->knee->foot direction has negative dy (descending toward the ground line at y=19), so the legs point down as required.
